boundaries: A Purpose Choice may be recorded even when consent is not the selected lawful basis; it must not be relabeled as a Consent Record.
Challenge participation does not imply research, model-training or employment-use consent.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One participant, consent-based purpose and notice version.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Consent Record meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: Evidence that a person made a specific informed choice for a specific approved purpose when consent is the selected basis.

boundary_conditions: A Purpose Choice may be recorded even when consent is not the selected lawful basis; it must not be relabeled as a Consent Record.
Challenge participation does not imply research, model-training or employment-use consent.
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Consent Record is attributable evidence that a participant gave or withdrew consent for one named processing purpose when the approved protocol uses consent as that purpose's lawful basis, bound to exact notice wording, scope and time.
